title: Grammatik Kanpeki card file
description: A set of cards. Used for the bundled data files and for import/export. Version 1 files are still accepted and upgraded on load (see upgradeCard in js/store.js).

progress.description: Optional review state per card id (only in exports with progress).

studyLog.description: Optional study history (only in exports with progress): answers per study day (YYYY-MM-DD, days start at 4 AM) and language. See js/studylog.js.

new.description: Cards answered for the first time

localized.description: Plain string, or an object keyed by language code (de, en, zh-Hant).

word.description: A hoverable word. Hovering shows its meaning; in a course with a word list it can be saved there.

text.description: The word exactly as written in the sentence (with furigana markup).

lemma.description: Dictionary form, if different from text (e.g. {歩|ある}く for {歩|ある}いた).

meaning.description: Meaning in the course's note language (de for German, zh-Hant for Japanese). Together with the lemma it identifies the sense that gets saved, so two meanings of one word become two cards.

pos.description: Part of speech, e.g. 名詞, 動詞, い形容詞, 副詞.

promptCommon.description: Prompt fields every card type understands.

translation.description: Translation of the sentence. Japanese shows zh-Hant right away; German hides each translation behind a click.

task.description: What to do, shown as a chip, e.g. ない形（否定）or Dativ Plural.

register.description: Which register the answer is in, shown as its own label beside the task. One of the course's registers (Japanese: plain 普通形, polite 禮貌); set only when the answer could be in either.

words.description: Hoverable words of the card's sentence (rewrite: source, cloze: sentence, flip: example), in order.

rewritePrompt.description: Card type rewrite: rewrite the whole sentence (Nominalisierung, Partizipialkonstruktionen).

clozePrompt.description: Card type cloze: fill the blank (動詞變化, 助詞, Deklination, Verben mit Präpositionen, ...).

sentence.description: Sentence with furigana markup; ___ marks the one blank to fill.

base.description: Optional word to start from, shown above the sentence (e.g. the dictionary form to conjugate).

pos.description: Part of speech, used when the filled-in answer is saved to the word list.

flipPrompt.description: Card type flip: see the word, recall the meaning, grade yourself (word list).

word.description: The word (dictionary form) with furigana markup. Shown on the front.

example.description: Example sentence with furigana markup (where the word was saved from).

id.description: Unique and stable. Import merges by id.

topic.description: Topic id from js/topics.js. Use the most specific topic (n-deklination, not deklination); parent decks include their sub-topics.

type.description: Optional. Normally the card type comes from the topic; set it only to draw this card differently.

source.description: Where the card came from, e.g. "demo", a book title, a URL.

prompt.description: Fields shown on the front. Which ones are required depends on the card type.

answer.description: What the learner types, and how it is judged.

accepted.description: Fully correct answers. The first one is the model answer. For flip cards, the meaning.

acceptable.description: Correct, but not so good (clumsy, colloquial, wrong register...). Each with a note why.

mistakes.description: Typical wrong answers with targeted feedback.

explanation.description: Shown after answering, with a tab per language the card has.

meta.description: Facets for filtering. Values the topic names in its `facets` show as chips, e.g. verbClass (godan, kami-ichidan, shimo-ichidan, irregular), adjClass (i, na), form (nai, te, ...).

savedFrom.description: Word-list cards: id of the card the word was saved from.

sense.description: Word-list cards: the saved sense, "<word without furigana>|<meaning>". Links the card to the hoverable word even after its meaning is edited.
